description: We are a team of six passionate about AI/ML, software development, and space exploration. We're excited to participate in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 and use technology to solve real-world problems!
summary:
**Space Mission Design Game** is an interactive educational simulator that transforms complex space engineering concepts into a hands-on mission design experience. Players take the role of a spacecraft engineering team, selecting scientific instruments and spacecraft components, configuring subsystems, choosing orbits and launch vehicles, and evaluating their mission designs.

Our solution addresses the challenge of making aerospace engineering more accessible by allowing learners to explore how real engineering decisions affect an entire mission. Through our V4 simulation engine, we evaluate interconnected engineering constraints, including mass and power budgets, communications requirements, and launch compatibility. We also distinguish between feasible, infeasible, and conditional designs when information is incomplete.

Scientific credibility is central to our approach. We use aerospace research and technical documentation, including NASA resources, while distinguishing published specifications from estimates and gameplay assumptions.

By combining engineering principles, simulation, and explainable feedback, our project helps students move beyond studying space missions theoretically and begin thinking like the engineers who design them.
